rationale: Existing Correlation specs cover embedded-tabs correlation (E1/E2), settings semantic groups (B1), cache invalidation (D3/D4), and the settings page surface (correlationSettings.spec.js). The remaining untested WIRED behaviors — full drawer dashboard via log-correlation-btn, ServiceIdentity save workflow, DiscoveredServices detail drawer, metric stream toggle, and trace correlation — form a coherent new spec in the Correlation/ area. Playwright auto-discovers all .spec.js under testDir, no manual registration required.
